baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن joins a prior judgment to the predicted absence of تَقُول ... كَذِبًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A belief carried as certainty after an indication is retrospectively confessed as failed because the expected absence of false utterance did not hold. The focus ayah therefore stages an epistemic reversal, not merely an accusation.

activation_trace.role: Certainty reached after an indication supplies the high confidence that the confession later overturns.
Articulated utterance makes the failed expectation concern publicly expressible speech.
Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the event whose occurrence breaks the prior certainty.

changed_reading.before: The speakers thought that neither humans nor jinn would lie about Allah.
changed_reading.after: The speakers confess that an indication-based certainty about trustworthy speakers collapsed when false divine attribution became possible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence تَقُول ... عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا binds saying, divine reference, and falsehood.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying branch includes speaking what never occurred or attaching words to another. Placed against the worshipped One, the failure is the appropriation of divine authority by manufactured attribution, not generic interpersonal dishonesty.

activation_trace.role: False saying or false attribution supplies the act of attaching an invented claim to an authority.
The worshipped One supplies the uniquely consequential authority against whom the attribution is made.
Falsehood in speech or action marks the attributed claim as contrary to truth.

changed_reading.before: Humans and jinn tell a generic lie concerning God.
changed_reading.after: Humans and jinn can manufacture a claim and place it upon divine authority, turning speech into unauthorized attribution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inward ظَنَنَّا precedes and evaluates the outward تَقُول, while the whole claim is voiced as a first-person confession.
baseline_models.mechanism: Uncertain supposition can be an unspoken saying in the self, and the false soul branch makes that inner discourse suspect. The first failed speech in the ayah may therefore be the speakers' own reassuring narration about others, even before any external lie is identified.

activation_trace.role: Weak or uncertain supposition supplies the fallible inward judgment being confessed.
An unspoken saying conceived in the self turns ظَنَنَّا into an internal speech event.
The soul named as false supplies a contained possibility of self-deception behind confidence in others.

changed_reading.before: The verse blames unreliable speech located wholly outside the confessing group.
changed_reading.after: The confession also indicts the group's own inner saying: their reassuring assumption was itself an unreliable discourse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated subjects الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ place visible human presence beside hidden spirit beings under one speech predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired subjects span perceptible and concealed social domains, while qawl can be circulating public report. The failed trust was therefore system-wide: speech from both visible and hidden channels was treated as mutually credible.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the perceptible side of the paired speaker field.
Hidden spirit beings supply the concealed side of the same speaker field.
Circulating talk supplies the medium through which the two domains can form one report ecology.

changed_reading.before: Two creature classes happen to be named as possible liars.
changed_reading.after: The ayah confesses misplaced trust in an entire visible-hidden report ecology through which claims about Allah could circulate.

context_deltas.mechanism: A newly heard, unfamiliar recitation with a concealed divine origin supplies direct evidence, while the immediately preceding saying is marked as foolish and far from truth. This revises the focus confession into a source audit: inherited confidence yields when received speech can be compared with an authenticated disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Divine report or inspiration supplies the newly authenticated origin against which prior claims are tested.
Hearing that becomes understanding and compliance supplies direct reception rather than secondhand reputation.
Recitation supplies the articulated evidence that can be heard and evaluated.
Wonder at an unfamiliar matter marks the evidence as disruptive of settled expectation.
Lightness of mind and deficient restraint classify the earlier speaker as an unreliable authority.
Deviation from truth supplies the diagnosed direction of that speaker's saying.

structural_cues: 72:1 orders concealed imparting, attentive hearing, and reported hearing before the retrospective confession in 72:5.
72:4 places a known speaker and his excessive saying immediately before the former universal confidence of 72:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies newly heard recitation and a prior saying labeled foolish and deviant; I infer that comparison with the new source breaks the old confidence. A live alternative is that the sequence reports conversion without making an explicit evidence protocol.

changed_reading.before: The speakers simply discover that their belief about truthful speakers was wrong.
changed_reading.after: Directly heard disclosure audits inherited reports, exposing their former certainty as confidence maintained without source comparison.

context_deltas.mechanism: The visible and hidden groups are not merely parallel speaker classes. Human men seek protection with jinn men, and the relation produces increase and overpowering burden. That patronage circuit gives concealed agents social authority and creates a feedback path through which claims can be trusted, repeated, and intensified.

activation_trace.role: Men on both sides supply matched social actors rather than abstract species.
Visible human presence supplies the dependent party entering the cross-domain relation.
Seeking refuge and protection supplies the asymmetry that grants another speaker authority.
Hidden spirit beings supply the concealed patrons whose claims are difficult to inspect directly.
Increase and growth supply the amplifying result of the relation.
Overwhelming and subjugating pressure supplies the harmful form taken by that amplification.

structural_cues: 72:6 duplicates رِجَال across the human-jinn boundary and connects the parties through يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ.
The final فَزَادُوهُمْ marks an outcome flowing from the relation rather than merely listing the two groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refuge across the human-jinn boundary followed by increased rahaq; I infer a trust and authority circuit capable of amplifying reports. Rahaq could instead be an outcome of the relation without speech being its transmission mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Humans and jinn independently produce false claims about Allah.
changed_reading.after: False divine attribution can be sustained by a patronage loop in which visible people authorize hidden patrons and the exchange magnifies oppressive excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact ظن ... أن لن pattern recurs around different outcomes. In 72:7 it is shared as a failed supposition; in 72:12 it supports recognition that neither terrestrial maneuver nor flight can escape Allah. The focus ظَنَنَّا is therefore confidence whose reliability must be calibrated by indication and outcome, not assigned one fixed strength.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain supposition supplies the shared mistaken pattern explicitly compared across groups.
Certainty after an indication supplies the contrasting, firmer use of the same judgment root.
Outrunning or escaping pursuit supplies the concrete impossibility now recognized with confidence.
Frightened flight supplies the second failed escape route that stabilizes the later judgment.

structural_cues: 72:7 echoes the focus with ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن and marks the assumption as shared.
72:12 repeats وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن but coordinates two failed escape routes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax and branch senses ranging from supposition to certainty; I infer deliberate epistemic recalibration through changed outcomes. Alternatively, every use may denote strong belief while only the proposition, not confidence level, changes.

changed_reading.before: ظَنَنَّا is a neutral mental verb meaning that the speakers thought something.
changed_reading.after: ظَنَنَّا names a once-confident but untested expectation whose epistemic quality is exposed by what later proves escapable, inescapable, or false.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaking jinn explicitly partition themselves into sound and other members, diverse paths, those who hand themselves over, and those who deviate. This internal differentiation revises the focus pair الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ: class membership cannot function as a warrant of truthfulness.

activation_trace.role: Soundness opposed to corruption supplies one positive subgroup within the speakers.
Otherness supplies members outside the named sound subgroup without forcing one homogeneous remainder.
Extended paths supply distinct courses along which members proceed.
Diverse paths and parties make the community's internal divisions explicit.
Handing over and relinquishing supplies one community response to the newly heard guidance.
Deviation from the right supplies the opposed community response.

structural_cues: 72:11 repeats مِنَّا ... وَمِنَّا and closes with طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا.
72:14 again repeats مِنَّا ... وَمِنَّا before contrasting responses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit intragroup partitions; I infer that these correct the blanket trust implied by treating a whole class as unable to lie. The correction is explicit for the speaking jinn and only analogically extends to humans.

changed_reading.before: The focus makes a factual mistake about two homogeneous species.
changed_reading.after: The focus confesses an epistemic mistake in using broad group identity as a truth credential despite real internal plurality.

context_deltas.mechanism: Listening access is watched, unseen knowledge is selectively disclosed to an accepted messenger, guards are inserted around the route, delivery is completed, and the whole process is comprehensively known and counted. This turns the focus problem into provenance: a claim about Allah is trustworthy through an authorized and guarded transmission path, not because its speaker is human, jinn, or hidden.

activation_trace.role: Auditory reception supplies the access point whose legitimacy is under scrutiny.
Watching and guarding supply enforcement against unlicensed listening.
Delivering a message supplies the speaker's constrained transmission task.
Messenger and message supply the authorized carrier and payload in the chain.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the protected information domain.
Disclosure and emergence supply the controlled transition from hidden knowledge to manifestation.
Acceptance rather than displeasure supplies selective authorization of the messenger.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the placement of guards within the transmission route.
Watching and guarding on the messenger's route supply chain protection at both ends.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and custody supplies end-to-end oversight of delivery.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies an auditable completion condition rather than vague assurance.

structural_cues: 72:9 places present listening beside an already prepared watcher.
72:26-28 forms a chain from hidden knowledge through selective disclosure and guarding to known delivery and exhaustive count.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restricted listening, selective disclosure, guarded routing, completed delivery, and comprehensive oversight; I infer that these together function as provenance control for divine claims. A live alternative is that the guards protect the mission or messenger without serving as a general truth-authentication model.

changed_reading.before: A claim about Allah is accepted or rejected mainly by judging the class of its speaker.
changed_reading.after: A divine claim requires guarded provenance from authorized disclosure through completed delivery; hidden-source prestige and group identity do not authenticate it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Firewood is gathered fuel and also carries a tale-bearing branch; a crowd becomes material piled layer upon layer, and fire appears as the consequence. These images activate a material-social reading in which false attribution is not an inert sentence but speech gathered, layered, and made consequential by circulation.

activation_trace.role: Gathered firewood supplies material that accumulates and becomes fuel.
Carrying firewood as tale-bearing or slander links gathered fuel to harmful speech circulation.
Material pressed layer upon layer supplies the social accumulation of repeated speech.
Kindled fire supplies the consequence fed by the accumulated material.

structural_cues: 72:15 makes the deviating group firewood, 72:19 depicts a piled multitude, and 72:23 names fire.
The focus itself couples saying with falsehood, keeping the material analogy anchored in speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies firewood with a tale-bearing branch, piled matter, and kindled fire; I infer a rhetorical arrow from circulating false speech to accumulated consequence. The three images may instead describe punishment and crowd behavior independently of a speech mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A lie about Allah is a discrete proposition uttered once.
changed_reading.after: False attribution has a material social afterlife: repeated circulation gathers and layers it into fuel for consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and must not replace the grammatical sense of تَقُول. It remains packet-anchored because the focus inventory explicitly supplies fewness and 72:24 repeats that same mapped branch beside number. Downstream prose should present it only as a metalinguistic frequency resonance around the categorical لَن, not as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The categorical expectation أَن لَّن تَقُول is activated by the non-dominant fewness branch attached to focus تَقُول.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant fewness branch reframes categorical impossibility as an unmeasured judgment that false attribution is effectively too scarce to occur.
Explicit fewness repeats the same mapped branch when comparative scarcity finally becomes an object of knowledge.
Counting the numbered supplies the measurement that the earlier absolute expectation lacked.

changed_reading.before: The speakers make only a categorical claim that false divine speech will never occur.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary resonance, their categorical never conceals an unmeasured frequency judgment: they treated such false attribution as too rare to count until actual number became knowable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a material expectation-failure branch of ك ذ ب is transferred into a speech setting. It remains valid as an exploratory layer because the focus names كَذِبًا and the later sequence joins promised future, sight, knowledge, and reaching the endpoint. Downstream prose should retain ordinary intentional falsehood as primary and qualify this only as an outcome-tested dimension of a claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَذِبًا carries a branch in which an expected supply disappears or does not last.

activation_trace.role: Milk failing to last as expected supplies a material image for a claim that does not hold up.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the eventual observation against which the claim is tested.
A promising sign from which a future state is expected supplies the expectation awaiting fulfillment.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic result once the promised matter is seen.
Reaching the endpoint supplies fulfillment of the transmission charge rather than mere verbal assertion.

changed_reading.before: كَذِبًا denotes only a speaker's intentional assertion of what is untrue.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary layer, false speech is also a claim that fails its expected duration or destination when later sight and completed delivery test it.

strongest_changes: Newly heard disclosure turns the failed assumption into a comparison between inherited report and authenticated reception.
Human refuge with jinn changes two speaker classes into an asymmetric feedback network that can amplify harmful claims.
Repeated ظن ... أن لن syntax and explicit intragroup plurality expose both confidence calibration and category-based trust as problems.
Guarded access, selective disclosure, messenger routing, delivery, and exhaustive oversight recast truth as a provenance question.
summary.what_was_special: The focus-only branches already distinguished failed certainty, unauthorized attribution, inner self-deception, and a visible-hidden report field. Context then supplied a social amplification circuit and an unusually explicit guarded transmission architecture; the split ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping also produced a contained frequency resonance at 72:24.
remaining_uncertainties: The refuge-to-rahaq relation clearly amplifies harm, but the packet does not state that speech is the medium of that amplification.
The guarded route may authenticate message provenance, protect the messenger, or do both.
The material fulfillment and frequency readings are branch-supported resonances, not replacements for the ordinary senses of كذب and تقول.
The repeated ظن forms permit confidence calibration, but their exact degree of certainty remains locally variable.
